CLAW.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Increase the damage of ALL your cards containing "Claw" by {Increase:diff()}.
CLAW.title: Claw
ALECSAA-CLAW_MACHINE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy {Repeat:diff()} times. 
Put a random 0 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} card from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
ALECSAA-CLAW_MACHINE.title: Claw Machine
ALECSAA-CONJURE.description:
Put ALL [gold]Souls[/gold] from your
[gold]Draw Pile[/gold] and [gold]Discard Pile[/gold]
into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
ALECSAA-CONJURE.title: Conjure
ALECSAA-HAMMERS.description:
Choose {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} in your
[gold]Discard Pile[/gold] to [gold]Transform[/gold] into
[gold]{Cards:plural:{IfUpgraded:show:Minion Dive Bomb+|Minion Dive Bomb}[/gold]|{IfUpgraded:show:Minion Dive Bombs+|Minion Dive Bombs}[/gold]}.
ALECSAA-HAMMERS.title: HAMMERS!!
ALECSAA-MINION_REINFORCEMENT.title: Minion Reinforcement
ALECSAA-FLICK.title: Flick
ALECSAA-TEMPERED_GLASS.description:
Glass does not lose damage
at or below {TemperedGlassPower:diff()}.
ALECSAA-TEMPERED_GLASS.title: Tempered Glass
ALECSAA-TURBULENT_TAKEOFF.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage twice.
Add 2 [gold]Debris[/gold] into your
[gold]Hand[/gold].
ALECSAA-TURBULENT_TAKEOFF.title: Turbulent Takeoff
ALECSAA-VITRIFY.description:
{IfUpgraded:show:[gold]Evoke[/gold]|Remove} all your Orbs.
For each Orb {IfUpgraded:show:[gold]Evoked[/gold]|removed},
[gold]Channel[/gold] 1 [gold]Glass[/gold].
ALECSAA-VITRIFY.title: Vitrify
